stats.text:
As a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}, you gain {ref:glossary/tremorsense} with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this Tremorsense. The stone can be natural or worked.

You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest}.
